courses.subject: RECR
courses.title: Leisure and Organized Recreation in the United States
courses.description: An analysis of the scope of leisure research, recreation services, the evolution of leisure, and the of individual recreation behavior.

courses.subject: RECR
courses.title: Administration of Therapeutic Recreation Services
courses.description: Emphasis on information specific to the administration of therapeutic recreation such as fiscal management, quality assurance, evaluation, marketing of therapeutic recreation, and other general administrative topics.

courses.subject: RECR
courses.title: Principles and Procedures in Therapeutic Recreation
courses.description: A study of the existing practices and principles of therapeutic recreation. An in-depth treatment of assessment/evaluation, goal setting and individualized planning, documentation, leisure counseling, and clinical skills.

courses.subject: RECR
courses.title: Independent Field Study
courses.description: Permission of the department. May be repeated for credit.

courses.subject: RECR
courses.title: Managing Organizational Behavior in Recreation Services
courses.description: This course addresses organizational behavior and theory to promote insight into micro and macro issues confronting professionals in organized recreation services.

courses.subject: RECR
courses.title: Issues and Trends in Recreation Management
courses.description: A seminar to involve graduate recreation students in in-depth analyses of selected topics, issues, and problems relevant to the recreation management in public and not-for-profit leisure service organizations.

courses.subject: RECR
courses.title: Issues and Trends in Therapeutic Recreation
courses.description: An analysis of selected issues, problems, and concerns in the provision of therapeutic recreation and inclusive recreation services.

courses.subject: RECR
courses.title: Internship in Recreation Administration
courses.description: Participation in full-time, practical on-the-job experience in a recreational agency of the student's choice.

courses.subject: RECR
courses.title: Internship in Recreation Administration
courses.description: Completion of a professional project and in-depth paper reflecting the outcomes of the internship completed in RECR 880 .

courses.subject: RECR
courses.title: Seminar in Leisure Studies
courses.description: A survey of contemporary views of society and their structures and functions, as they relate to concepts of leisure and recreation behaviors.

courses.subject: RECR
courses.title: Recreation Research Design and Methods I
courses.description: An appraisal of current recreation and leisure research design using both quantitative and qualitative data. Students complete and deliver a formal research proposal.

courses.subject: RECR
courses.title: Recreation Research Design and Methods II
courses.description: Required preparation, any statistics course. Students analyze quantitative and qualitative data and apply their work to theory and practice. Students complete the research proposed in RECR 950 .
